recognize_zh: 低倍下一個巨大的結節幾乎佔滿整個視野，以深染的小淋巴球為主，中央夾雜淡染、界線不清的生發中心殘塊，外套區與生發中心分界消失，是進行性生發中心轉化（PTGC）的特徵。
features: Single very large nodule occupying most of the field
Predominance of small dark lymphocytes infiltrating the nodule center
Pale, ill-defined fragments of residual germinal center within the nodule
Loss of a distinct mantle zone/germinal center interface
Thin capsule-like fibrous rim and adjacent lymphoid tissue at the edges
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows a very large nodule composed predominantly of small lymphocytes, with pale, poorly delineated residual germinal center fragments dispersed within it and loss of the normal mantle-germinal center interface. No large atypical cells are identifiable at this magnification, although cytologic detail is limited. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers; IgD highlights the mantle-cell infiltration, and absence of LP cells should be confirmed to exclude NLPHL.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows multiple large nodules replacing the node with scattered LP cells (CD20+, EMA+/-, CD15-/CD30-) rosetted by PD1+ T cells.
Floral FL has monotonous neoplastic follicles with BCL2+/CD10+ germinal center cells and light-chain restriction, unlike reactive PTGC.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows monocytoid/marginal zone B cells colonizing follicles, often IgD-negative and with plasmacytic differentiation, rather than IgD+ mantle cells.
